verdict.rationale: Nothing in the evidence addresses AI training policy. The only relevant mechanism is indirect: Zulip can be fully self-hosted with the same software as Zulip Cloud, and export/import tools let you move off the hosted service, so your data can stay on servers you control. missing for 10: any explicit policy or setting covering AI/model training on customer data, a documented opt-out for Zulip Cloud users, and independent corroboration.
